preview: Sarah: Good night, and thank you for your service. Georges will be in touch tomorrow.

messages.text: Is there a military or disabled veteran discount?

No veteran or military discount I can give — the listed price is the price. I've passed it to Georges, who handles anything on pricing; he picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and you'll get his answer by email.

Anything about the Airsquitter itself I can help with while you're here?
Handed to the team · discount request — pricing decisions need a person
Just say hi to George and JD for me.

Will do — I'll pass that along to Georges and JD.

Before you go, one thing: what's keeping you on the fence about the Airsquitter?
Nope, In perfect WHSing and flight line location, just San Diego, Ca. is expensive, and any little help, helps.

Understood — San Diego isn't cheap, and a flight line location is about as good as it gets for an Airsquitter.

Pricing is Georges' call, not mine, so I won't guess at it. He has your note and picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET, with the answer to your email.
Good night, and thank you for your service. Georges will be in touch tomorrow.
